label: D1 before an a2 choice, especially after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of activation mass; never at GO or D2) and almost only when the agent is about to choose a2: phase==D1 & action==2 gets 97% recall but only 27% precision. Its magnitude is mostly carried by D1 steps where the reward input is 0. prev_reward==0 holds 91% of the mass, while rewarded D1s give weak activations. The recorded predicate (D1, upcoming choice a2, previous trial unrewarded) reaches dev F1 0.55 with mass recall 0.88. The action is the agent's own upcoming choice, which it computes, so the predicate uses no future random outcome. It does not fire before a1 choices (3% of mass). Activation is highest when the D1 policy logit leans moderately toward a2 (choice in about -4.4 to -1.5) and the value estimate is middling (7.1 to 7.5), and it is silent at strongly a2-confident or high-value steps. Adding a choice-logit band raises F1 to only 0.61, so the predicate stays incomplete: many unrewarded D1s before an a2 choice do not activate it. Reads as an a2-leaning, uncertain-after-no-reward signal at D1.
